description: This Java class serves as a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application, providing structured error responses for various exceptions like NotFoundException, validation errors, and illegal arguments.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring component annotated with @RestControllerAdvice to handle exceptions globally across REST controllers, returning structured error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException by returning a 404 structured response with timestamp, status, error message.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors from MethodArgumentNotValidException, providing details about field errors.

methods.name: handleIllegalArgument
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException, returning a 400 error with message.
